create_pipeline_prompt2prompt: create a Prompt2PromptPipeline instance for Stable Diffusion text-to-image generation with cross-attention editing
run_pipeline_image_edit: run the Prompt2PromptPipeline __call__ method to generate images with replace, refine, or reweight edit types
build_attention_controller: build an AttentionReplace, AttentionRefine, or AttentionReweight controller for cross-attention modification during diffusion
test_local_blend_masking: test LocalBlend to mask and blend image regions based on prompt word attention maps
summarize_refinement_mapper: summarize get_refinement_mapper to align token sequences between source and target prompts using global alignment
